Her voice continues unbroken across the MT 7:14|8:1 seam: דּוֹדִ֖י צָפַ֥נְתִּי לָֽךְ (oshb:Song.7.14 = web:Song.7.13, byte tier) 'my beloved, I have stored up for you' — her 1cs perfect under the dodi vocative — runs directly into מִ֤י יִתֶּנְךָ֙ (oshb:Song.8.1, byte tier) 'who would give you', אֶֽמְצָאֲךָ֤ and אֶשָׁ֣קְךָ֔ (oshb:Song.8.1, byte tier) 'I would find you' / 'I would kiss you', all 1cs verbs carrying 2ms object suffixes; no gendered form changes and no vocative or imperative onset marks a new addressee across that seam.
